# OpenNile
> Local commerce platform connecting customers with local businesses.

OpenNile helps people discover nearby shops, place pickup or delivery orders, message businesses, and pay securely — all in one app. Business owners get a storefront, order management, and payouts from one dashboard.

- Launch market: Rochester, MN, USA
- Status: Pre-launch (waitlist open)
- Website: https://opennile.com
- Contact: info@thirtyfivestudio.com
- Phone: +1 (651) 219-8788

## Key pages
- Home: https://opennile.com/
- Privacy: https://opennile.com/privacy
- Terms: https://opennile.com/terms

## What OpenNile does
- Discover local businesses and products nearby
- Order for pickup or delivery
- Message businesses directly
- Secure checkout and order tracking
- Business dashboard for products, orders, customers, and payouts

## FAQ
Q: What is OpenNile?
A: A local commerce platform connecting customers with local businesses across the United States.

Q: Is OpenNile free for customers?
A: Yes. No platform fees for customers.

Q: Where is OpenNile available?
A: Launching first in Rochester, MN, expanding across the USA.

Q: How do businesses join?
A: Sign up on the waitlist at opennile.com.
